set.nav.tutorial: Settings sidebar and page title for the feature ledger and tutorial replay.
set.nav.guide: Settings sidebar and page title for the per-widget user guide.
set.tutorial.replay: Button in Settings > Tutorial that opens the isolated practice demo from the beginning.
set.tutorial.replay_hint: Short explanation beside the replay button. It must say that practice data is not saved.
set.tutorial.level: Heading for one tutorial ledger level. {n} is the level number 1, 2 or 3.
set.tutorial.seen: Accessible status appended to a tutorial entry the user has already encountered.
set.tutorial.whats_new: Heading for the current version's newly introduced tutorial entries.
set.guide.try: Button on a widget Guide entry that opens an isolated demo focused on that widget type.
set.backup.open_folder: Settings > Backup and data: button that opens the WidgetBoard data folder in File Explorer. Replaces the old tray item.
set.about.report: Button in Settings > About. Opens an anonymous Google Form in the browser to report a bug. 1 to 3 words.
set.cal.subs: Settings > Calendar fieldset title: read-only calendars imported from an .ics / iCal link (Google, Outlook, Naver). Short label.
set.cal.subs_hint: Hint under the subscribed-calendars title: where to find the secret iCal link in Google Calendar, that imported entries are read-only, and the 3-hour refresh. Keep Google's own label for the field.
set.cal.sub_name_ph: Placeholder of the subscription name box. The name also becomes the entries' tag in the calendar.
set.cal.sub_url_ph: Placeholder of the subscription link box. Short.
set.cal.sub_refresh: Button: download every subscribed calendar again now.
set.cal.sub_at: Status after a subscription's name in the list: {n} entries, {when} = date and time of the last successful download.
set.cal.sub_pending: Status after a just-added subscription that has not been downloaded yet.
set.cal.sub_failed: Status after a subscription whose last download failed; the technical reason shows as a tooltip. The last good copy stays in the calendar.
set.cal.sub_bad_url: Browser validation bubble on the link box when the text is not an https:// or webcal:// link.
themes.title: Settings > Appearance: heading of the theme picker (one card per theme folder). Short.
themes.hint: Under the theme picker: a theme is an image in the themes folder; repainting and saving it changes the board at once. One or two sentences.
themes.none: First theme card: no theme folder, use the colour settings below it on the page. Short.
themes.open_folder: Button: opens the themes folder in Explorer.
themes.save_current: Button that opens a name box to save the current look as a new theme folder. Ends with an ellipsis.
themes.save: Button next to the name box: saves the theme.
themes.code_copy: Button: copies the active theme as a short text code (WB1:...) for chat apps.
themes.code_paste: Button that opens a box to paste a theme code. Ends with an ellipsis.
themes.code_apply: Button under the paste box: makes a theme from the code and uses it.
themes.code_copied: Toast after copying a theme code. Full sentence.
themes.code_bad: Toast when the pasted text has no theme code; says what a code starts with. Full sentences.
themes.pasted: Folder name for a theme made from a pasted code (numbered when repeated). 2 words.
themes.exists: Toast when the typed theme name is already used. Full sentences.
themes.saved: Toast after saving a theme. {name} is the theme name.
themes.active_note: Note above the colour pickers while a theme folder is in use: the theme's painted colours win over these pickers. {name} is the theme. Full sentences.
